authors.bio: Brad Gilmer is president of Gilmer & Associates, Inc., a technology and management consulting firm and is also the editor-in-chief of the File Interchange Handbook. He currently serves as the executive director of the Advanced Authoring Format Association and as executive director of the Video Services Forum. Gilmer was also co-chair of the File Interchange committee of the Pro-MPEG Forum and a participant in the EBU/SMPTE Task Force. Gilmer held various posts during a 14-year career at Turner Broadcasting Systems, Inc., before he left to start his own firm in 1997. He graduated Summa Cum Laude with a degree in business from Georgia State University.
